title: Card
description: Generic surface container with the shadcn Card's named parts: CardHeader stacks a centred CardTitle (react-aria Heading, level picks the element; display-lg, bloom-800) over a centred CardDescription, and CardFooter rows up the actions. Two materials by variant: flat (default), the bark-50 sheet with a bark-200 hairline; glass, for a card floating on a ground: the primary button's pane on a surface, a radial fill lit from the top-left over a backdrop blur, a specular top edge, the translucent ring and a bloom-tinted drop.

anatomy.description: A div with data-slot="card" and data-variant. flat: bark-50 surface, bark-200 hairline border, the house radius. glass: a radial fill of bark-50 lit from beyond the top-left corner (95% there, 75% at the edge) over a 16px backdrop blur, a needle-50 border, a 1px needle-50 specular line along the top edge, a 1px translucent inner ring, and a 6px/6px 18px bloom-700 drop at 22%. Accepts any div props and a className to extend.
data-slot="card-header": a column with 0.125rem gap and 0.5rem below, for the title and description.

react-aria Heading with data-slot="card-title": display-lg, weight 700, bloom-800, centred and balanced (text-wrap: balance). `level` picks the element (h2 by default; a card that is the page's main content passes 1).
A p with data-slot="card-description": text-base, bark-600, centred, the muted intro under a title.
data-slot="card-footer": a row of actions with 0.5rem gap; extend it to stack actions.

usage: Compose content inside; Card owns only the surface, border and radius, never padding conventions of its children.

Pick the material by placement: flat inside the shell's inset, where a card separates by border and tint; glass only for a card that floats on a ground (the FullBleedCanvas), where the photograph should show through. Never glass on a flat page.

The glass recipe is the pane chosen at /lab/glass on 2026-09-24 (the primary button's light on a surface); the baseline and the three other alternatives stay there as the archive. A change to the recipe is made there first, then here.

Controls inside a glass card keep the extruded recipe, but the theme re-tunes both lift tokens for them (a :where() rule on the glass surface: the highlight a neutral bark-50 at chroma 0 and 30%, the shade bloom-700 at 10%) because the needle tint reads green through the translucent surface and the full shade too heavy. Nothing to do in a consumer; never override the token per control.
Prefer extending Card over drawing a bordered box in a route or feature module.
A card's title and intro are CardTitle and CardDescription inside CardHeader; never restate their size or colour in route CSS (theming §1.6).
CardContent is deliberately not ported: Card already pads. Put the body straight inside Card between the header and the footer.
Promotion precedent: a private descendant becomes a top-level component like this one when a second, unrelated component needs it.
